<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
function quietReviewRight() { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I:", $incoming, ";"; return true; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): int { echo "G:", $incoming, ";"; return null; }
};
$selector = "null";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = empty($reader->$selector); }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getLine(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "EMPTY_KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
try { $destination = $reader->$selector ?? quietReviewRight(); }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getLine(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "COALESCE_KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "null" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
function quietReviewFallback() { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "ISSET;"; return true; }
    public function __get(mixed $incoming): int {
        global $reader;
        echo "GET;";
        $reader = null;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; throw new Exception("receiver-coalesce"); }
};
$selector = "gone";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $reader->$selector ?? quietReviewFallback(); }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getLine(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo $selector === "gone" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php

$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "ISSET;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): int {
        global $reader;
        echo "GET;";
        $reader = null;
        return null;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; throw new Exception("receiver-empty"); }
};
$selector = "gone";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = empty($reader->$selector); }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getLine(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo $selector === "gone" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
